name: Two calls to the Isle

date.label: The Burning Crusade · patch 2.4 quest entry

summary: From Shattrath came two calls to the isle’s work. Aldor agents sent the seeker north with “Crisis at the Sunwell,” while the Scryers offered “Duty Calls.” The choice began on opposite sides of the Terrace of Light, yet both led across the sea toward Quel’Danas and the staging ground near the fount.
